wargear.name: Mirror-cloak
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A shimmering mantle that throws back a dozen false outlines of its wearer. The bearer gains Shrouded (6+), or one step better if they already have it.

wargear.name: Reagent injector
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A wrist-mounted cocktail of stimms and counter-toxins, tuned for agents who expect to be poisoned in return. The bearer gains Feel No Pain (6+).

wargear.name: Sleeper-cell beacon
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A tiny pulse-caster that lets scattered cells act on a single plan without a word on the vox. Every model in the unit gains +1 Cool and +1 Intelligence.

option.text: The Headhunter Prime may exchange their power dagger for
Any Headhunter may exchange their bolt pistol for a Viper dart pistol
Any Recon Legionary may exchange their Astartes shotgun for a Coil-spined needle carbine
Any Scout may exchange their bolter for a Coil-spined needle carbine
The Sergeant may wear a Mirror-cloak
The unit may carry a Sleeper-cell beacon

modifiers.text: Trained to kill the head, not the body: +1 BS, -1 CL.
Every legionary a cell leader: +1 IN, -1 LD.
Shadow-killers with no home to return to: +1 BS, -1 CL.
Hardened by purge after purge: +1 LD, -1 M.

rites.name: A Hundred Cells, One Hand
rites.flavor: No cell knows the plan. Every cell knows its part.
rites.text: Headhunter Kill Teams, Seeker Squads and Reconnaissance Squads may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1). The scheme has no room for armour: no Armour, Heavy Transport or Lord of War units. At least two Headhunter Kill Teams are required.

modifiers.text: A Hundred Cells, One Hand: Line (1).

require.note: Field at least two Headhunter Kill Teams.

rites.name: The Sleeper Awakens
rites.flavor: They were standing beside you before the war began.
rites.text: Tactical Squads, Veteran Tactical Squads and Inductii Squads gain Infiltrate (9) and cost 5 points more. Sleepers do not ride to war: no Transport or Heavy Transport units, and no Fast Attack units.

rites.name: The Hydra's Gambit
rites.flavor: Alpharius is present, and three other Alpharii are also present.
rites.text: Exodus costs 40 points less and Headhunter Kill Teams cost 25 points less. Exodus, Headhunters and Mor Deythan gain Hatred (Command). Alpharius must lead the army, and the gambit leaves little room for line infantry: at most one Tactical Squad and no Veteran Tactical Squads.

rites.name: Dreadwing Purge-Host
rites.flavor: When the whispers fail, the Dreadwing is sent to finish the argument.
rites.text: Dreadwing Interemptor Squads and Lernaean Terminator Squads may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1). Interemptors gain Rending (6+) in close combat and shooting. The purge moves at a walking pace: no Recon or Fast Attack units. At least two Dreadwing Interemptor Squads are required.

require.note: Field at least two Interemptor Squads.
